independentMeaningAndMasking.meaning: Two direct reader calls stop throwing and the independent CLI verification returns ok:true against a damaged fixture. These are actual reader/admission assertion failures, not generic refusal or setup failure.

All eight managed-provider/mode/damage combinations fail first at status line 258. Their earlier healthy installation and revoked-state checks passed. Forwarding, no-fetch, reinstall refusal and protected-byte assertions later in the body are masked in this mutant; they remain baseline/restored passing fixture checks.

The separately signed schema-malformed fixture passes the signature-valid precondition at line 296 before managed status at line 297 fails. Valid signature is not treated as valid schema or agent truth.

Both combined CLI/Bridge cases pass healthy Bridge and healthy-store revocation preconditions, then stop at CLI line 318 after damage. The later damaged-store Bridge assertion at line 321 assertion is not reached; no independent mutant Bridge kill follows.

All six writer variants fail only at final reader assertion at line 58. Writer-refusal at line 56 and exact list/signature snapshot at line 57 passed first. These six failures establish reader sensitivity, not writer fail-open or writes by the mutant writer.

The two router and two gateway HTTP cases pass unchanged in this mutant. They are real loopback requests with five-second AbortSignals. Gateway cases include healthy 200 and upstreamRequests = 1, then damaged 401 and still1; router cases begin with a revoked/damaged lease and have no healthy protected-route positive. No all-consumer sensitivity or broad network-isolation claim follows.

Removed-entry, missing-list, missing-signature and invalid-signature each fail missing writer refusal at line 56; the deliberate-repair distinction fails ordinary-revoke refusal at line 79. Later snapshot/reader/repair assertions are masked. No exact post-failure filesystem effects are inferred from those unexecuted assertions.

Healthy append/idempotent update, first-revocation bootstrap, unavailable-signer preservation, invalid JSON and signed-malformed schema cases pass. Raw parsing still rejects the latter two; their green outcomes do not restore authentication of parseable damaged stores.

Current reader verifies and parses one captured list buffer. The writer authenticates that prior snapshot under its existing control-file lock and signs the next bytes before first publication. Two separate atomic file writes at lines 153/154 do not prove atomic pair publication, crash consistency, cross-process race behavior or rollback anchoring.

limits: This independent lane only read frozen receipts, source and filesystem bytes. It did not import AMC, run or rerun tests, compile, install, mutate inputs, execute held code, change Git metadata or perform network requests.
The launcher fingerprint directly observes Node v22.23.3 and ABI127; each test command selects the explicit Node22 path. A separate per-worker ABI fingerprint was not printed and is not invented.

The copied source files have independent regular bytes and no .git metadata. This is a fresh filesystem copy, not literal fresh-clone qualification. Its 12,268-file closure excludes node_modules and symlinks; 307 resolver links were separately checked and the native file identity was separately pinned.
